crossRefs.note: Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of…
“If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not…
If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;
if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,
so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.
For the vineyard of Yahweh of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for…
Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?
Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out, and the cries of…
“ ‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall…
If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which Yahweh your God gives you…
“The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are…
But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!

translations.web: Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews.
translations.bsb: About that time there was a great outcry from the people and their wives against their fellow Jews.
translations.kjv: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.
translations.asv: Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.
